thread:
rachel-partners: Heads-up 1: We need to finalize marketplace pricing dimensions and the embargo schedule for the joint AWS+Azure listing with Nimbus Systems. Also need localization plan for EN/DE/JP landing pages. Who's owning each lane?

tom-product: I can lead pricing and SKU mapping. Proposal: two SKUs 01: pay-as-you-go metered per inference-second, and 02: committed monthly seat for high-volume users. Need meter names for AWS Metering Service.

priya-legal: I'll take embargo + partner terms. Quick ask: does the partner want co-sell language or referral-only? That changes the contract template. Also need to review any marketplace-specific IP clauses.

dan-finance: FYI co-sell triggers different revenue share accounting. Tom, can you put expected price points (list and suggested discount tiers) by EOD? We need to model ARR estimates.

wei-portal: I'll own the listing metadata and localization. Need final copy strings and partner-provided logos. For DE/JP translations we prefer short copy (<=120 chars) for hero. Can marketing produce POA copy by Tue?

gabe-si: SI integration checklist: provisioning flow, entitlement check, and auto-provision webhook. We need a sandbox meter from AWS for testing. Also request a small sample invoice line to validate billing parser.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS Marketplace manifests require a product code (70 chars max) and a short description < 1024 chars. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace.

emma-marketing: I can run localization for hero + bullets. Will need partner blurbs and one customer quote in each language. Can Nimbus provide native speaker review for DE/JP?

rachel-partners: Nimbus said they'll provide logos and a single translated quote in JP by Wednesday. They asked if we can host localized pages under /marketplace/nimbus. Wei, ok?

wei-portal: Yes, subpath works. Need final assets by Wed noon to hit staging deploy on Thu. Also confirm canonical locale keys: en-US, de-DE, ja-JP.

priya-legal: Embargo proposal: partners get embargoed brief on Thu 18:00 PT, embargo lifts Fri 10:00 PT after final smoke. If anyone needs a different window, flag now. Also attaching partner NDA addendum for marketplace listing.

tom-product: SKU meter names (draft): "inference_second" and "committed_seat_month". Dan, suggested list price: $0.0008 / inference_second and $499 / seat/month. Model revenue with 10K inference-seconds/day and 50 seats for first year.

dan-finance: Running the numbers now. Quick check: do we pass-through marketplace fees or absorb? That affects our net rev. Preference: pass-through for pay-as-you-go, absorb for committed seats. Need partner signoff.

gabe-si: For testing billing, can ops provision a test invoice that includes both meter types? I can validate entitlement -> provision mapping.

emma-marketing: For hero language (EN): "Redwood + Nimbus: scalable inference for edge-first apps". I'll draft DE/JP copies and paste to staging doc. Need short CTA variations too.

rachel-partners: Action owners recap:
- pricing & SKU listing: tom-product -> draft today
- embargo & contract wording: priya-legal -> draft Tue
- listing metadata + staging deploy: wei-portal -> deploy Thu
- SI billing/integration test: gabe-si -> test invoice by Thu
- localization & creative: emma-marketing -> drafts Mon/Tue
- finance rev model: dan-finance -> inputs by EOD

marketplace-bot: Note: Remember to include a support email and 24/7 contact for paid SKUs in the manifest.

priya-legal: Also one legal note: marketplace logos must include partner trademark attribution. I'll add the exact attribution text to the CLA.

tom-product: Uploaded pricing spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood/pricing/nimbus-marketplace-v1. Please comment. If no major edits, I'll freeze by 18:00 PT.

dan-finance: :white_check_mark: initial model done. Looks viable with pass-through on PAYG. Will share sensitivity slices.

wei-portal: Staging slot requested for Thu 06:00 PT. I'll queue the deploy once I have localized strings and images.

gabe-si: Test invoice template posted to the Jira ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/PM-7888. Please review.

emma-marketing: Uploaded localized hero drafts in the marketing doc. Ping me for wording tweaks. Nimbus confirmed JP review.

rachel-partners: Great progress. One last thing: press list. Do we want a coordinated partner co-announcement or staggered regional? Thinking single global lift to maximize PR oomph. Thoughts?

priya-legal: Global lift is fine provided embargo and translations are aligned. We'll need translated legal notices for DE/JP if local counsel requests.

dan-finance: Global is fine from finance side but watch for regional tax/marketplace fee differences. I'll add notes.

tom-product: Agree global. Marketing and partners coordinate. If all owners complete items, proposed launch timeline: Wed final assets -> Thu staging validation -> Fri go/no-go -> Fri 10:00 PT lift.

rachel-partners: OK locking that timeline unless objections by EOD. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your lane is ready.

wei-portal: :white_check_mark: staging slot reserved, waiting assets.

emma-marketing: :white_check_mark: localized copy in doc.

gabe-si: :white_check_mark: billing test template posted.

priya-legal: :white_check_mark: embargo notice template uploaded.

dan-finance: :white_check_mark: finance model uploaded.

tom-product: :white_check_mark: pricing sheet frozen at 18:00

rachel-partners: Thanks all 1  We'll reconvene Tue morning if any blockers pop.
